search_space: The singleton candidate space consisting of X = ∅ and the unique empty function f on X. The program sweeps that entire one-candidate space and checks both existential attainment conditions.
witness_description: Take X = ∅ and f to be the unique empty function on X; then ‖f‖ also has empty domain.
refutation_explanation: Attaining either a minimum or a maximum requires some x in X at which the relevant value is attained. Since X = ∅ has no element, ‖f‖ attains neither, contradicting the claim that it attains both when nonemptiness is not assumed.
